newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says has not yet seen Holzmann case.
newsitem.headline: EU says has not yet seen Holzmann case.

text.p: European Commission officials said on Tuesday they had not yet seen a proposal by Hochtief AG and Deutsche Bank AG to jointly control Holzmann AG.
The officials would not comment on whether the Commission would agree to a request by the German Cartel Office to regain control over the deal.
Hochtief and Deutsche Bank are expected to request the Commission to clear the agreement, which gives them control of 50 percent of Holzmann, under the European Union's merger regulation.
Under the merger rules, corporate alliances must be notified to the Commission within a week of being announced.

Hochtief and Deutsche Bank said this week they were pooling their shareholdings in Holzmann in what was seen as an attempt to escape the Berlin cartel office's long-standing opposition to cooperation between the country's two largest construction firms.
